target.exe: cataclysm.exe (GOG "Homeworld: Emergence"; CET loader hard-codes this name)
target.notes: Source: CataclysmEngineTweaks commit 19a08c3 + hw_rgl 41ff3c3. All addresses are absolute VAs in the GOG build; CET performs NO version/hash/size/timestamp check, only GetModuleHandle(NULL)==0x400000 (dllmain.cpp:11-17) and never rebases. "patch_site" = instruction address CET overwrites (Keystone) or detours mid-function (MinHook); "data" entries named universe_* / *_hyperspaceState / tpGameCreated_* are DERIVED from global base + struct offset. Expected original bytes are inferred, not checked by CET. Verify every entry against the real exe before trusting it. Byte check vs GOG build 12948 (cataclysm.exe sha256 f03d9a3e...) on 2026-10-08: notes tagged [exe 12948] were read from the real exe; see docs/cet-knowledge.md "## Verification".
